title: MCIPAC-MCBBO 5760.2 Support for Non-Federal Entities and Private Organizations
publisher: Marine Corps Installations Pacific-MCB Camp Butler
locator: pp.1-2 tasks 3(b)(1)-(6); enclosure pp.1-2 to 1-8 paras 1,5-10,13-19; especially pp.1-6 to 1-8 paras 16-19
support_scope: MCIPAC authorization chain; NFE/non-NAFI status; reporting; license and reimbursable utilities/services; own equipment; limited logistical support; status suspension/revocation; resale exceptions
interpretation_limit: A general order does not prove that a named PO received a particular room, free support, subsidy, license, or retail exception; actor-specific authorization and license documents remain separate

title: Private Organizations current roster and program description
locator: program description; current PO list rows for American Welfare & Works Association, Marine Officers' Spouses' Club Okinawa, and Marine Thrift Shop; resources section
support_scope: Current active-status roster and MCCS PO Monitor role; listed organizations
interpretation_limit: Roster placement is administrative authorization evidence, not MCCS affiliation, control, funding, endorsement, or proof of a specific facility license

title: Request for Approval of a Private Organization
locator: pp.1-3: request to Director MCCS; officers; projected income/expenses; EIN; membership; assets; insurance; dissolution and acknowledgements
support_scope: Application fields and acknowledgment of non-governmental status and PO responsibility
interpretation_limit: A blank template does not show that a named organization supplied any field or received approval

title: Private Organization reporting requirements checklist
locator: quarterly financial statements, minutes, compliance checklist and POC list; annual financial statement/review, budget and bylaws review
support_scope: Documents routinely required from MCIPAC POs
interpretation_limit: Template requirements show an administrative record class, not that records for every named PO are public or retained for every year

title: Fundraiser and Limited Logistical Support Request Form
locator: event/site fields; facility manager endorsement; legal review; Camp/Station Commander decision; final approval and non-endorsement language
support_scope: Event-level site and limited logistical-support approval path
interpretation_limit: A request form does not prove approval, free use, an ongoing facility right, or actual provision of equipment/services

title: 18 FSS Operating Instruction 34-223-1 Private Organizations Program
publisher: 18th Force Support Squadron Kadena Air Base
support_scope: Kadena authorization/monitoring; private liability; administrative file; limited supervision; continuous resale authorizations; normal fees for 18 FSS support; suspension/dissolution
interpretation_limit: The order names two continuous-resale operations but does not publish their lease, permanent-room, rent, utility, or current post-2025 classification terms

title: Private and Unofficial Organizations
publisher: Kadena Air Base 18th Force Support Squadron
locator: visible page description and contact block; local HTML around lines 471 and 542-550
support_scope: Current public explanation that POs are self-sustaining and operate with installation-command consent
interpretation_limit: Building 721-A Room A-108 is the 18 FSS Private Organization program contact office; it is not evidence of a spouse-club room or free facility

title: Kadena Town Hall Meeting Minutes: Private Organization Program changes
locator: June 12 2025 town hall; new mission-related/community-based PO types; spouse-club classification to be clarified in forthcoming policy memo
support_scope: Temporal caveat for current Kadena PO categories
interpretation_limit: A forthcoming-classification statement does not cancel the 2024 order or identify the present classification of KOSC/OESC

title: DoD Directive 1000.26E Support for Non-Federal Entities Authorized to Operate on DoD Installations
locator: policy paras 3-4: NFE definition; installation commander consent; non-preferential treatment; conditional logistical support
support_scope: DoD-wide distinction between NFE status, installation consent and conditional support
interpretation_limit: DoD-wide policy does not establish actor-specific Okinawa authorization, facilities, payments or support

title: MCO 5760.4C Procedures and Support for Non-Federal Entities Authorized to Operate on Marine Corps Installations
locator: enclosure paras 1-10 and 17: written consent; disclaimer; out-grant for regular facilities; limits on NAF support; MCCS administrative oversight
support_scope: Marine Corps-wide parent rule for facility out-grants and administrative oversight
interpretation_limit: Parent policy is context for MCIPAC; named-organizational facility or support facts require the installation/order/actor document
